source.name: LTA MRT Station Exit (GEOJSON)
source.attribution: Contains information from LTA MRT Station Exit (GEOJSON), accessed on 2026-10-14 from data.gov.sg, made available under the Singapore Open Data Licence 1.0.

selection.method: Operating MRT stations present in the matching routing-network whitelist; one record per physical station.
selection.distanceMethod: Minimum local haversine distance to the official exits; station latitude/longitude is an exit centroid fallback.
selection.limitations: Straight-line distance is not a walking route. Exit availability is not live. The whitelist must be updated with the routing network before newly opened stations can be selected.
